notes.title: Unknown Pleasures: 5 great new Steam games you might have missed
notes.notes:
Welcome back to Unknown Pleasures, our weekly round-up of hidden gems released with little-to-no fanfare on Steam over the past seven days.

This week: cowboy vs space-whale, voxel swordplay, deft Gameboy throwback and 6 degrees of freedom space-racing.
(more…)

notes.title: Arrowpoint Lives
notes.notes:
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/3oxHQzrCtkvjtB4jRe/giphy.gif[/img]

Welcome beautiful people! I just hit "Release" and Arrowpoint is now live on the Steam store! Thanks to all of you who encouraged me throughout the game's development, and hello to all you new players just discovering the game. I hope you enjoy Arrowpoint and can't wait to hear from you in the forums!

With love, Alex

notes.title: The only game where you ride a horse, fire arrows, and battle a giant, cyborg whale!
notes.notes:
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/l4EoTInmdFC6VblKg/giphy.gif[/img]

Hi everyone, I'm really excited to share Arrowpoint with you! It started out as a simple rails shooter, but then a friend said, Alex, you've got to do something more -- what about a whale? What indeed! Well, I won't bore you with another fish story, but suffice to say I took the idea and ran with it.

With love, Alex
